name: Kapitsa
description: Serve Qwen, Nemotron, Flint and Clover models on Apple Silicon with a native C++ engine on Metal kernels and the Neural Engine, without an MLX or llama.cpp runtime.
compatibility: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages, /v1/responses) and a chat page.
Starts opencode, Claude Code, Codex or pi on a local model with one command.
Imports Qwen or Flint GGUF files from LM Studio, Ollama or llama.cpp.
limitations: Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 14 or later; no Linux or Windows.
Memory: the README points 16-24 GB Macs at the 9b model (or 4b); larger models such as the 35B-A3B need more.
Runs the models in its catalog and imported Qwen or Flint GGUFs; Flint, Clover, the text-only Nemotrons and the 35B's 16gb build read text only.
Checks GitHub once a day for a new release and can update itself; KAPITSA_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 or kapitsa update --auto off turns this off.
